llm_response.reason: The site heavily impersonates Lazada by copying their branding, copyright, and e-commerce structure, yet the domain is unrelated. It pushes urgent app installations, features gambling/lottery promotion (S8TOTO), has suspicious external links for critical actions (login, register, support), lacks legitimate business contact information, and covers an overly broad range of products. These clearly match characteristics 3, 5, 6, 10, 13, 14, and 16 of scam websites.
